description: This Java source file contains JUnit integration tests (CountIT class) for testing complex search criteria on a persistence layer related to 'things' in the Eclipse Ditto project. It verifies counting functionality with various criteria such as attribute matching, authorization, and deletion effects.

classes.name: CountIT
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing count operations with complex criteria on the Ditto persistence layer.

methods.name: countAny
methods.description: Tests counting all matching 'things' without authorization restrictions.

methods.name: countAnyWithoutAuthorization
methods.description: Tests counting with no authorization, expecting zero result.

methods.name: countEquals
methods.description: Tests counting 'things' with attribute equal to a specific value.

methods.name: countWithNoMatchingResults
methods.description: Tests counting with criteria that match no existing 'things'.

methods.name: countIgnoresDeletedThings
methods.description: Ensures deleted 'things' are not included in count results.

methods.name: insertThingWithAttribute
methods.description: Helper method to insert a 'thing' with specified attribute and value into persistence.

methods.name: getPolicyEnforcer
methods.description: Overrides to provide specific policy enforcer based on namespace.

methods.name: createOtherPolicy
methods.description: Creates a different policy for testing purposes.

methods.name: executeCount
methods.description: Executes a count query with specified criteria.
